metadata.mapping_method: A block is listed under a taluk when the LGD Block-With-Covered-Village export contains at least one village whose LGD sub-district code/name in the LGD Village-to-Gram-Panchayat mapping matches that taluk.
metadata.important_note: LGD's covered-village export does not encode a simple one-parent Taluk→Block hierarchy. Some development blocks have covered villages in more than one sub-district/taluk; such blocks therefore appear under each relevant taluk. This is a cross-reference, not an invented administrative parent relationship.
metadata.verification_status: District and taluk names/codes are from LGD exports. Block names/codes are from the latest uploaded LGD block export. Taluk-to-block associations are derived only by matching official LGD village codes between the two uploaded LGD exports.
